author: world today news
title: Software Engineer II Position Available
text:
Are you a seasoned DevOps Engineer looking to advance your career? Bank of America is seeking a skilled professional to drive continuous delivery initiatives. Learn about this exciting possibility to shape the future of finance by building and maintaining critical CI/CD pipelines and implementing cutting-edge DevOps practices.
Bank of America Seeks DevOps Engineer to Drive Continuous delivery Charlotte, N.C. — Bank of America is actively recruiting a DevOps Engineer to enhance its software delivery automation and champion Continuous Delivery best practices.
Opportunity Overview: Shaping the Future of Finance Through Technology Bank of America is seeking a skilled DevOps Engineer to play a pivotal role in configuring complex software delivery automation. The accomplished candidate will ensure software deployments meet stringent access, ownership, and authentication standards. This position offers the opportunity to refine code for software deployment automation and uphold Continuous Delivery methodologies for complex, high-availability applications.
The role requires integrating development,testing practices,software delivery tools,and runtime application standards within the bank’s ecosystem.
Key Responsibilities: Architecting the CI/CD Pipeline The DevOps Engineer will be responsible for:
Configuring and maintaining tools and services that provide Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) services. Validating access control mechanisms for the Software and Infrastructure Engineering team throughout the software development lifecycle. Reviewing application server configurations to ensure CI/CD service platform onboarding pre-requisites are available and properly configured. Monitoring and responding to alerts based on key performance indicators (KPIs) for CI/CD services. Escalating events and issues from DevOps Engineers, creating issues and action-plan summaries for stakeholders. mentoring and clarifying issues and practices for DevOps engineers. collaborating with Infrastructure,Solutions Engineers,and Site Reliability Engineers to understand changes in CI/CD service platform components and planned changes in monitoring and alerting capabilities. Responding to risk or audit-identified issues with access control processes designed for compliance with firm separation of duties practices,and software release management standards and policies. Executing change tickets for CI/CD service onboarding and decommissioning using approved change management processes as scheduled by Software or Infrastructure Engineers. Required Qualifications: Skills and Experience Candidates should possess the following qualifications:
hands-on experience in container configuration and complete setup. Experience with DevOps tools such as Bitbucket , ansible, and XLR. Experience with Openshift . Experience in Java/J2EE technologies. Hands-on experience with development tools like Eclipse and Splunk. Hands-on experience with code quality tools like sonar/Crucible. Experience with modern development methodologies, including Agile. Ability to design, implement, and maintain cloud-based solutions using AWS, Azure, and/or GCP. Proficiency in monitoring and optimizing cloud infrastructure performance. Skill in developing and maintaining automation scripts for cloud deployments. Desired Qualifications: Enhancing the Candidate profile Preferred qualifications include:
Strong dialog and interpersonal skills. Good analytical skills and problem-solving ability. Container/cloud experience. Core Competencies: A Blend of Technical and Soft Skills The ideal candidate will demonstrate proficiency in the following skills:
Analytical Thinking Collaboration DevOps Practices result Orientation Solution Delivery Process Adaptability Application Development Influence Innovative Thinking Risk Management Architecture Project Management Solution Design stakeholder Management Technical Strategy Development Bank of America: A Commitment to Growth and Inclusion Bank of America emphasizes its commitment to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. Being a Great Place to Work is core to how we drive Responsible Growth , the company states. This includes attracting and developing remarkable talent, supporting teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness, and recognizing and rewarding performance.
The bank aims to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection , driving responsible growth and delivering value to clients, teammates, communities, and shareholders.
Shift details: Standard Hours This position is for the 1st shift in the United States, with a standard work week of 40 hours.
Bank of America is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.
